notes: *even* before *four generations* is `added`: both object markers stand on the sons phrases, which the ASV renders bare, and rule 16 forbids reaching across the clause for a marker to carry an appositional *even*.

The possessive run *his sons' sons* follows rule 29's possessive reading — the determiner-position *his* to the suffix on the rectum, the first *sons* to the rectum `בָנָיו`, the second to the construct `בְּנֵי` — since an English possessive precedes its head noun.
Variant WLC.JOB.42.16.v004 is underdetermined with the base reading retained; it is not a rule 53 exclusion and no English is affected.
